SillyTavern visual system

The Chronicle Set

A gallery-first rendering layer for Shinobi World. Markers stay simple in the prompt, while the regex set turns them into portrait headers, parchment thoughts, and dramatic dialogue records.

System status

4visual scripts
159exact portraits
1safe fallback

Approved portraits resolve only from Sillytavern/Shinobi World/Gallery/. If there is no exact match, the system uses the NPC plate instead of inventing an image.

How it works

Marker → gallery → rendered Chronicle

The four scripts are namespaced with SW so they do not collide with the older Global set.

01

Write a marker

Use a compact tag such as [SWCHAR|filename|Name|#HEX] in the generated text.

02

Resolve exactly

The lorebook preserves the exact gallery filename and the character’s era, costume, form, or status.

03

Render the state

The regex replacement hides the marker and displays the matching visual component in the chat.

Lorebook contract

What the image rules protect

  • Exact filename binding. The file name is treated as the source of truth.
  • Exact form matching. Academy, Genin, Edo Tensei, KCM, curse mark, timeskip, and other forms remain separate.
  • Gallery-only portraits. The resolver points to the installed Shinobi World gallery, not a guessed web image.
  • Fallback instead of substitution. If no exact binding exists, use [SWNPC|Name|#HEX|Role].
Never substitute Do not invent Catbox IDs, external URLs, base64 images, alternate filenames, or a different form of the same character just to fill a portrait slot.

How the resolver chooses an image

The lorebook and Chronicle set are designed to keep form-specific portraits correct.

01

Read the marker

Extract the exact gallery filename, display name, and accent color from [SWCHAR|…].

↓
02

Check the installed gallery

Resolve only inside Sillytavern/Shinobi World/Gallery/. No outside URL is generated.

↓
03

Fallback safely

When an exact form is unavailable, use SWNPC so the wrong portrait is never shown.
